entries.0a1dc433923d4874: This is the stage that researches, develops, makes and sells prescription drugs.
entries.0dbd700c6157bad9: This is the field of companies and materials that support the manufacture of drugs. It includes accepting contract manufacturing from drug manufacturers, supplying active pharmaceutical ingredients, and handling components such as filters used in manufacturing biopharmaceuticals.
entries.0f4235ecf859ecd7: This is the stage that operates dispensing pharmacies, which hand drugs to patients who bring a prescription.
entries.32a150437c13a934: This is the stage that purchases drugs and medical-related products from drug manufacturers and sells them at wholesale to hospitals, clinics and dispensing pharmacies.
entries.441f8fe6b57a2a5a: This is the stage that purchases drugs and medical-related products from drug manufacturers and sells them at wholesale to hospitals, clinics and dispensing pharmacies. In addition to prescription drugs, it handles diagnostic reagents, medical devices and materials, and over-the-counter drugs.
entries.46281cefb005a913: This is the industry that researches and makes drugs and medical devices used to treat illness, and delivers them to hospitals and pharmacies. Drug manufacturers carry out everything from research and development to manufacturing and sales, and also sell overseas. Pharmaceutical wholesalers sell drugs purchased from drug manufacturers to hospitals and dispensing pharmacies at wholesale. At dispensing pharmacies, drugs are handed to patients who bring a prescription.

entries.c76767a41856fe8d: This is the stage that operates dispensing pharmacies, which hand drugs to patients who bring a prescription. Some companies also support home medical care and provide nursing care services.
entries.c91296fbe496d876: There is a transaction in which absorbable topical hemostatic material is sold to a company that sells it exclusively in Europe.
entries.d330689e04546170: There is a transaction in which absorbable topical hemostatic material is sold to a company that sells it exclusively in Europe. That company falls under the electrical and electronics industry.
entries.da678310335af51d: This is the stage that researches, develops, makes and sells prescription drugs. In fields such as cancer, neurology and gastroenterology, it also makes antibody drugs, plasma fractionation products and vaccines. Medical devices such as endoscopes, catheters and hemostatic materials are also made at this stage.
